# Jaison David

## About

Jaison David is a Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer and Full-Stack Developer. His documented technical focus includes Go (Gin), Apache Kafka, Redis, MySQL, Docker, Nginx, React, Next.js, REST APIs, and event-driven systems.

## Education

Jaison David is pursuing a B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at Bannari Amman Institute of Technology in Erode, Tamil Nadu, from 2025 to 2029.
